Evident Amérique du Nord représente environ un quart des revenus du Groupe Evident et comprend des activités de fabrication et de R&D à Québec, State College et Waltham. Le Canada constitue un important centre de fabrication et de développement qui soutient les activités mondiales.
 L’Assistant contrôleur sera responsable de diriger les activités de comptabilité, de présentation de l’information financière, de conformité et de gouvernance des entités canadiennes d’Evident, tout en soutenant, au besoin, les activités et la présentation de l’information financière de l’Amérique du Nord. Ce rôle est responsable de veiller à l’intégrité des états financiers, au respect des exigences réglementaires, à l’efficacité des contrôles internes et à la transmission en temps opportun de l’information financière à la société mère.
 Le titulaire du poste collaborera étroitement avec les dirigeants de l’entreprise, les équipes comptables mondiales, les fournisseurs de services externes, les auditeurs ainsi que les équipes des finances corporatives.
 La personne retenue jouera un rôle clé dans les initiatives de transformation de l’entreprise, notamment la mise en œuvre d’un ERP, les activités liées à la sortie des TSA, l’harmonisation des processus et l’intégration au modèle opérationnel financier de Wabtec.
 Le titulaire du poste supervisera une équipe de trois professionnels de la comptabilité et favorisera une culture axée sur la responsabilisation, l’amélioration continue et le partenariat avec l’entreprise. Le succès dans ce rôle sera évalué en fonction de l’exactitude et de la rapidité de la présentation de l’information financière, de la solidité de l’environnement de contrôle, de la réalisation réussie des initiatives de transformation, de la gestion efficace des fournisseurs de services tiers et du développement d’une équipe comptable hautement performante.
 Responsabilités : 
 Diriger les activités comptables, la clôture mensuelle et la présentation de l’information financière des entités canadiennes.
 Assurer la production des rapports destinés à la société mère et soutenir les exigences liées à la consolidation mondiale.
 Soutenir et réviser le travail des fournisseurs de services impartis afin d’assurer l’exécution efficace des processus « Record-to-Report », « Order-to-Cash » et « Procure-to-Pay ». Le BPO est responsable de l’ensemble des activités transactionnelles; il est donc essentiel de superviser son travail afin de s’assurer que les activités sont réalisées adéquatement, notamment en matière d’exhaustivité, de respect des délais et de qualité.
 Veiller au respect des normes US GAAP, des exigences réglementaires, des règles fiscales et des contrôles internes.
 Diriger les audits externes et soutenir les activités d’audit interne et liées à la conformité SOX.
 Analyser les résultats financiers, expliquer les écarts et fournir des recommandations concrètes aux dirigeants de l’entreprise.
 Soutenir les activités liées à la trésorerie, notamment les opérations bancaires, les paiements, la gestion de la trésorerie et les exigences en matière de gouvernance.
 Diriger la mise en œuvre de l’ERP, les initiatives de transformation de l’entreprise et l’amélioration des processus.
 Soutenir les acquisitions, les intégrations et divers projets spéciaux.
 Développer et encadrer les membres de l’équipe comptable tout en favorisant un environnement de travail axé sur la haute performance.
 Qualifications 
 Formation et expérience pertinente 
 Baccalauréat en finance ou en comptabilité requis; titre de CPA fortement souhaité. Un MBA constitue un atout.
 Minimum de 7 ans d’expérience en comptabilité financière et en contrôle financier, incluant la supervision directe d’employés, idéalement dans un environnement corporatif international nécessitant des interactions avec plusieurs divisions et des entités à l’étranger.
 Une expérience au sein d’un cabinet Big 4 à titre de CPA au niveau gestionnaire constitue un atout important.
 Connaissances, compétences et aptitudes essentielles 
 Capacité démontrée à exercer un leadership efficace dans un environnement d’affaires dynamique et en constante évolution, soumis à d’importantes transformations, notamment la mise en œuvre d’un ERP, l’évolution du modèle opérationnel, la standardisation des processus et les initiatives d’intégration organisationnelle.
 Solides compétences en leadership et en développement des talents, avec une capacité démontrée à bâtir, accompagner, encadrer, développer et fidéliser des équipes comptables et financières hautement performantes.
 Style de leadership pratique et mobilisateur, avec la capacité de conjuguer réflexion stratégique et exécution opérationnelle, tout en offrant un soutien lors des périodes critiques du cycle d’affaires et des périodes de changement.
 Connaissance approfondie des normes US GAAP, de la présentation de l’information financière, des contrôles internes et de la gouvernance comptable, ainsi que capacité à appliquer les normes et directives comptables techniques à des situations d’affaires complexes.
 Solide sens des affaires et capacité à comprendre les processus opérationnels de bout en bout, à cerner les répercussions interfonctionnelles et à évaluer les risques et les occasions sous les angles financier et opérationnel.
 Expérience dans la gestion et la collaboration avec des fournisseurs de services impartis (organisations BPO), avec la capacité de favoriser la responsabilisation, la qualité des services et l’amélioration continue des processus partagés.
 Expérience démontrée dans la direction ou le soutien de mises en œuvre d’ERP, de migrations de systèmes financiers et d’initiatives de transformation de processus à grande échelle.
 Excellentes capacités d’analyse et de résolution de problèmes, notamment la capacité à interpréter des informations financières complexes, à cerner les tendances et les principaux facteurs de variation et à formuler des recommandations concrètes à l’intention de la haute direction.

 Excellentes aptitudes en communication écrite, verbale et en présentation, avec la capacité de communiquer efficacement avec la haute direction, les auditeurs, les partenaires d’affaires, les équipes des finances corporatives et les parties prenantes externes.

 Esprit axé sur les résultats et engagement marqué envers la responsabilisation, l’excellence dans l’exécution, l’amélioration continue et le service à la clientèle.

We are investing heavily in our Distribution Centre, inventory capabilities, technology, people, and systems as we build toward our long-term growth strategy. 
 This is not simply a purchasing role.
 The VP of Product will have executive accountability for Product Assortment, Inventory Strategy, Purchasing, Pricing, Category Management, and Product-related Technology and Analytics .
 The Opportunity 
 The VP of Product will answer some of the most important commercial questions in our business:
 What should we sell?
 What should we stock, where, and how much?
 Which suppliers and product lines should we grow?
 How should we price by market, category, and customer?
 Where should we enter new categories?
 How can data and technology improve these decisions?

 Build a Smarter Inventory Network
 Lead AES’s enterprise-wide inventory strategy across our Distribution Centre and branch network. Improve fill rates and product availability while reducing excess, obsolete, and unproductive inventory.
 Grow and Optimize the Product Assortment
 Identify assortment gaps, rationalize underperforming SKUs, evaluate new categories, and ensure our product mix reflects actual customer and market demand across Automotive, Agriculture, Industrial, Heavy Duty, and PBE. 
 Lead Pricing Strategy
 Drive the continued evolution from traditional cost-plus pricing toward more data-driven, market-aware pricing designed to improve contribution margin while maintaining competitiveness.

 Transform purchasing into a more strategic, analytical function. Strengthen vendor relationships, improve supplier accountability, negotiate stronger commercial programs, and align purchasing decisions with demand, inventory, and financial outcomes. 
 Build a Disciplined New Product Process
 Ensure new product lines and categories are supported by clear business cases, expected ROI, required inventory investment, launch plans, and post-launch accountability.
 Use Data and Technology as a Competitive Advantage
 Work with internal and external technology partners to improve pricing, demand forecasting, product recommendations, customer insights, inventory positioning, and master data.

 What You Bring
 We are looking for a commercially minded, analytical leader who understands the connection between product, inventory, pricing, purchasing, data, and customer demand .

WHY WE NEED YOU? GLAD YOU ASKED...
 
We are seeking a versatile and highly skilled Data Scientist to join our dynamic team. This role is pivotal in driving data-driven decision-making across our B2B initiatives, with occasional contributions to our B2C sector and Adtech initiatives. You will be responsible for developing sophisticated models, conducting deep-dive analyses, and extracting actionable insights from complex datasets to optimize user experience and advertising performance.

This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of B2B weather intelligence and commercial data products, influencing the direction of our predictive algorithms under the mentorship of the Team Lead of Data Science working closely with leadership to align data strategies with business objectives. We offer a collaborative environment where innovation is encouraged and data-driven insights are at the heart of everything we do. 
Please note, we are only considering candidates who are eligible to work in Canada and can work in a Hybrid model at our Oakville location
 

WHAT DOES THE DAY-TO-DAY LOOK LIKE: Build Predictive Weather Models : You will design, train, and deploy machine learning and spatio-temporal models to integrate weather feeds with client sales data to predicting demand, optimizing forecasts, and quantifying operational risk.
 Derive Actionable Insights: You will conduct end-to-end exploratory analysis on complex meteorological datasets to uncover high-value patterns and translate probabilistic trends into strategic recommendations.
 Drive B2B & Commercial Growth : You will partner with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Support to build analytics solutions for B2B initiatives.
 Optimize ML Performance: You will leverage distributed frameworks (e.g., PySpark, Dask, Ray) and modern ML stacks (Scikit-learn, PyTorch/TensorFlow, LLMs) to improve model speed, scale inference pipelines, and lower compute costs.
 Own the Model Lifecycle: Take responsibility for the full end-to-end lifecycle, including testing, deployment, and ongoing monitoring to ensure production-grade stability and reliability.
 Technical documentation: Actively document model architectures, data lineage, and decision logic to ensure reproducibility, facilitate peer review, and maintain long-term institutional knowledge.
 Cross-Functional Collaboration: You will partner closely with Data Engineers, Product Managers, and Revenue leaders to embed predictive algorithms into live APIs and deliver scalable data products that solve real-world enterprise problems.
WE ARE HOPING YOU HAVE: Degree in a STEM discipline (Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field); a Master’s or PhD is preferred but not required. 
 3+ years of data science experience specializing in B2B environments, with expertise in spatio-temporal modeling, time-series forecasting, and weather data intelligence. 
 High proficiency in Google BigQuery (SQL, window functions, query optimization, and large-scale data manipulation).
 Advanced expertise in Python for statistical modeling, data science, and graphical visualization (e.g., Matplotlib, Seaborn, or Plotly), with hands-on experience using core ML libraries including NumPy, SciPy, Scikit-learn, and TensorFlow or PyTorch. 
 Experience working with distributed computing frameworks (e.g., Apache Spark) to process large-scale datasets. 
 Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain complex ideas to an audience with a non-technical background
NICE TO HAVE: Proven experience developing and deploying Deep Learning models in industry or research environments. 
 Familiarity with deploying Large Language Models (LLMs) or retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines for automated reporting, intelligent customer support routing, or unstructured data processing. 
 Experience scaling models across large datasets using distributed processing frameworks.

If you are looking for interesting and challenging work, at a company committed to its people, find out more about what Aviso has to offer at www.aviso.ca .
 The Opportunity: 
 We’re looking for an experienced and detail-oriented Senior Reviser to join our dynamic Translation Services team that is part of Aviso’s Communications team.
 This role is a 12 month contract working 4 days per week. 
 Reporting to the Senior Manager, Translation Services, the Senior Reviser/Translator will be responsible for accurate and quality revision and translation of materials based on industry and brand specifications and established internal processes, policies, and service levels for our French-speaking audience. 
 As one aviso: 
 We Care – You do the right thing for clients, partners and colleagues. You build trusted relationships, champion service excellence, and contribute to a culture where people feel valued and supported
 We Dare –You challenge the status quo with bold ideas and fresh perspectives. You embrace change, seek opportunities to innovate and are comfortable exploring new ways of working
 We Share – You collaborate openly and build meaningful relationships. You seek out diverse perspectives, share your knowledge and work together to help colleagues, clients and partners succeed
 We Deliver – You take ownership of your work, honour your commitments and focus on delivering meaningful results. You hold yourself accountable and continuously look for ways to improve
 What your day looks like: 
 Ensure materials for our French-speaking audience are delivered with the highest quality in accordance with industry and brand specifications based on internal processes, policies, and service levels
 Ensure linguistic quality through our translation vendor channel by providing feedback on outsourced translations, carrying out industry-specific research and providing input on terminology usage to our vendors
 Proofread work performed by other team members when required
 Ensure accurate and quality revision/translation of material produced for our French-speaking markets, including brochures, financial commentaries, advertising material, presentations, correspondence, online communications, website material and statements
 Stay abreast of regulatory changes (such as Bill 96), financial market news and world events that may impact the industry to ensure accuracy of translations and terminology usage
 Identify reputational and other risks in translation requests and escalate when appropriate
 Maintain consistency of terminology by contributing to an internal terminology database (Multiterm)
 Requirements 
 Your experience and skills: 
 7+ years of experience as a reviser/translator with 5+ years of experience as a reviser (preferably in financial services or a related industry)
 Knowledge of financial markets and terminology as well as relevant regulatory requirements; the successful completion of the IFIC and/or the CSC is an asset
 Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in French and English, including editing, spelling, and grammar
 Superior time management skills and the ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment
 Excellent knowledge of Windows, Antidote, and translation aids (SDL Trados & Language Weaver)
 An understanding that success is in the details. You notice things that others don't.
 Driven by the collective success of a team that values trust and accountability
 The desire to be part of an inclusive team that enjoys working together to bring a shared vision to life
 Benefits

 Email & Retention Design

 Present work with a clear rationale — why this layout, this hierarchy, this CTA — to internal teams and, when needed, clients

Who we are 
 About Stripe 
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career. 
 Research at Stripe 
 Stripe’s mission is to increase the GDP of the internet and expand economic access globally. We design tools and infrastructure to help our users start, run, and scale an online business from anywhere in the world. We believe there are too many barriers to doing business on the internet and that opportunities are not equally distributed around the world. We also believe that building and growing a business online is a problem rooted in code, language, and design, not finance.
 That’s where you come in. We’re looking for an experienced UX Research Manager to join our growing UX Research team and help build, coach, and mentor a growing and highly skilled group of researchers.
 About UX research and the role 
 The UX Research team is part of Stripe’s Design team. It works across brand and product initiatives to deliver products and experiences that meet user needs. Since Stripe’s main audience is people who build products, we take pride in creating user-friendly, user-focused experiences.
 In addition to conducting primary research, we enable other Stripes, including engineers, product managers, designers, and operations teams, to learn and apply research skills to global problems. You will help shape research as a core competency across Stripe and define how we put users first in our research.
 What you’ll do 
 As a UX Research Manager, you will use your people-management and research expertise to lead a team of researchers that collaborates with product teams on core Payments and Risk products to build insight-driven product experiences. Core Payments includes Stripe’s in-person and online payment capabilities, checkout suite, Radar, and smart solutions that help businesses achieve optimal payment performance while balancing regulatory requirements, conversion, costs, and fraud considerations.
 You will report to the Head of Research.
 Responsibilities 
 Lead, manage, coach, and mentor a team of researchers conducting mixed-methods research throughout the product-development process for Stripe’s Payments and Risk product pillar.
 Lead initiatives and guide the research team through artificial intelligence (AI) transformation in its internal processes, how it conducts research for Stripe users, and how it supports the changing needs of product partners.
 Share research insights that deepen Stripe’s understanding of user needs and identify opportunities to meet those needs.
 Grow the team to meet Stripe’s needs while developing individual contributors to deliver impactful, actionable research studies.
 Partner with Design and Stripe leadership to determine how to best use user research at Stripe and deepen our understanding of users.
 Work as a strategic partner to business leads, product managers, design leaders, and Stripe leadership. Define long-term strategy and short-term tactics for products by grounding decisions in user needs and insights.
 Prioritize research needs and approaches across multiple workstreams. Select the right project, scale, and scope at the right time, and deliver actionable insights.
 Enable other Stripes to learn and apply research skills by building research programs, platforms, and toolkits that support tactical research.
 Partner closely with other researchers to build Stripe’s research practice and infrastructure, including sourcing research vendors to support your team’s work.
 Who you are 
 We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. 
 Minimum requirements 
 7+ years of relevant user research experience working on digital experiences and generating actionable insights that drive impact.
 3+ years of people-management and leadership experience.
 Experience directly managing, coaching, and developing a team of user researchers, as well as recruiting and building research teams.
 Ability to set and achieve priorities that balance the needs of users, projects, the Research team, and Stripe.
 Experience conducting project work while mentoring and supporting a team of user researchers as they develop their craft and conduct research.
 Preferred qualifications 
 Relevant experience in financial technology, particularly payment processing.
 Ability to motivate and inspire people to do their best work.
 Experience conducting complex research at scale using a range of methods, including qualitative interviews, surveys, ideation sessions, ethnographic field research, usability evaluations, and diary studies.
 Experience conducting primary research while mentoring and supporting a team of user researchers as they develop their craft and conduct research.
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience rolling out large-scale research programs.
 A consistent focus on users and their needs, with experience driving impact from insights.
 Understanding of the balance between speed and rigor, and how research translates into design, product, and business decisions. Ability to work with urgency and focus while adapting methodological rigor to the situation.
 Experience building or scaling research platforms, systems, or programs.

ARE YOU THE KIND OF PERSON WHO MAKES A GREAT FIRST IMPRESSION? 

Then Jobber might be the place for you! We’re looking for a Sales Development Representative (SDR) to join our Sales team!

Jobber exists to help people in small businesses be successful. We work with small home service businesses, like your local plumbers, painters, and landscapers, to transform the way service is delivered through technology. With Jobber they can quote, schedule, invoice, and collect payments from their customers while providing an easy and professional customer experience. Running a small business today isn’t like it used to be—the way we consume and deliver service is changing rapidly, technology is evolving, and customers expect more. That’s why we put the power and flexibility in their hands to run their businesses how, where, and when they want! 

Our culture of transparency, inclusivity, collaboration, and innovation has been recognized by Great Place to Work, Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures, and more. Jobber has also been named on the Globe and Mail’s Canada’s Top Growing Companies list, and Deloitte Canada’s Technology Fast 50™, Enterprise Fast 15, and Technology Fast 500™ lists. With an Executive team that has over thirty years of industry experience of leading the way, we’ve come a long way from our first customer in 2011—but we’ve just scratched the surface of what we want to accomplish for our customers https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EkfZmHrRLx4&list=PLoktA_D-2UEnxMLfCe93bANKXVXd2bdN8&index=24.

The team:

Our Sales team gains an understanding of who our customers are, what their businesses do, and how Jobber can help them succeed, to turn leads into advocates.

This team is one that celebrates the wins, motivates each other over the losses, and challenges each other to do better every day. You’ll have regular 1:1’s with your manager which focus on performance, coaching, and long-term development, with consistent feedback on how you can continue to grow. This is a target based role where you will be working towards achieving daily and monthly KPIs, and have the opportunity to compete in both monthly and quarterly contests (Spifs).

The role:

Reporting to a Manager, Sales Development, the Sales Development Representative (SDR) is often the first touch point for potential customers, so making a good impression is paramount. You'll be qualifying leads of businesses that started a trial of our software to better understand whether we are able to help and support their business. It's important that you are able to generate excitement and build value for the next step of them speaking with the Account Executives who will champion the relationship. 

The Sales Development Representative (SDR) will:

 - Connect with potential customers through a variety of inputs (phone, text, email).

 - Work with members of the Account Executive (AE) team to provide the best customer experience and exposure to the Jobber product.

 - Be open to giving and receiving feedback on a consistent basis to grow yourself and those around you.

 - Track key information in Salesforce for follow-up and analytics.

 - Have dedicated time to participate in learning opportunities and self-guided work to further your sales skills and development.

To be successful, you should have:

 - Previous success in sales. If you were a top performer in selling cell phones, electronics, or other tech, or a retail star - this position is for you.

 - To be a self-starter. The SDR will likely dial over 100 calls per day to effectively support the sales process. We need someone who is energized by moving fast, not depleted by it.

 - To be incredibly driven and tenacious. In sales, not every customer will say yes or be interested in what you have to say. We need you to dust off your jeans and get right back in the saddle...quickly.

 - To collaborate. The SDR must establish strong relationships quickly and work with the Sales team to understand what is and isn’t working.

 - To be adaptable. We’re an agile company and we need people who are able to pivot and change directions when required.

 - To be a strong and confident communicator. You have the ability to actively listen and converse with our customers, and get a true understanding of who they are and what they need.

Compensation:

At Jobber, we believe that compensation should be transparent, fair, and supportive of your experience and growth. This opportunity has a fixed compensation structure, meaning all employees come in at the exact same rate.  It includes a base salary of $46,300 and a commission of $15,000, for an On-Target Earnings (OTE) of $61,300. Our commission structure is uncapped and paid out monthly, meaning there is potential to earn beyond the stated OTE. 

This OTE is just one part of a total compensation package that will include equity rewards, annual stipends for health and wellness, retirement savings matching, and an extended health package with fully paid premiums for body and mind. As well, this role has clearly defined growth opportunities to deepen expertise, explore new roles, or step into leadership. You’ll have access to a dedicated talent development program that includes career coaching and opportunities for career development.

If you have any questions about our compensation approach, we encourage open conversations throughout the hiring process!

The Interview Process:

Step 1: We’ll review your application! The candidates whose sales experience aligns with the role will be moved forward in the process. We're looking for problem solvers, and people used to working in a fast-paced and multi-tasking environment. Make sure to highlight this one your application!  

Step 2: AI interview! Candidates moving forward will receive a link to complete a brief, AI interview through Metaview.

Step 3: Convo with TA! A member of Talent Attraction will reach out to you for a conversation. We want you to answer any questions you may have and speak about next steps. 

Step 4: Team Interviews!  You’ll have two interviews with your potential team leader and peers to dig into your previous experience and performance, as well as to see your skill set in action in a Customer Support role play. We’re constantly raising our bar and excited to see what you can bring to Jobber.

Step 5: Offer!

What you can expect from Jobber:

 - A total compensation package that includes an extended health benefits package with fully paid premiums for both body and mind, matching in RRSP, TFSA or FHSA, and stock options.

 - A dedicated Talent Development team and access to coaching, learning, and leadership programs to help you grow your career, reach your goals, and unlock your full potential.

 - A unique opportunity to build, grow, and leave your impact on a $400-billion industry that has no dominant player...yet.

 - To work with a group of people who are humble, supportive, and give a sh*t about our customers.

We believe that diverse teams perform better and that fostering an inclusive work environment is a key part of growing a successful team. We welcome people of diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to working with applicants requesting accommodation at any stage of the hiring process.



A bit more about us:

Job by job, we’re transforming the way service is delivered. Your lawn care provider, home cleaning service, plumber or painter could use Jobber to better connect with their customers, save time in the office, invoice faster, and get paid! We’re bringing tens of thousands of people together with technology to deliver billions of dollars a year in services to happy customers. Jobber exists to help make these small businesses successful, and when they’re successful we all win!

 Balance Disruption with System Coherence: Serve as the pioneer who tests how far the brand can stretch on social, working iteratively with the core Brand team to refine bold ideas into polished, brand-aligned assets.

 What you’ll bring to the role 
 5–8+ Years of Visual Art Direction Experience: A proven track record in-house at a fast-growing tech/B2B brand or at a top-tier creative agency driving social-first visual campaigns.
 Solid Graphic Design Foundation: A strong grasp of graphic design principles—typography, hierarchy, grid systems, composition, color theory, and layout.
 Basic Motion & Video Familiarity: Solid understanding of basic motion principles and simple animation workflow (Figma motion, basic After Effects/Premiere, or similar). Advanced motion skills are not required, but you have a keen eye for pacing, video storytelling, and directing motion specialists effectively.
 Boundary-Pushing Mindset: A portfolio demonstrating bold, outside-the-box conceptual thinking that proves you know when and how to break visual rules to capture attention.

Georgian is a Toronto-based venture capital firm that partners with high-growth technology companies across cybersecurity, AI software, robotics, defense. We manage about $6B in assets and we have invested in more than 80 companies that we support with capital and technical capability.

This role will represent Georgian at the highest levels of LP engagement, supporting the scale of our platform across Growth Funds, Breakout Funds, and SPVs. It is a senior-facing position with significant exposure to Georgian's Founders and leadership team, requiring a high degree of autonomy, judgment, and executive presence.

Unlike traditional Capital Formation roles, success at Georgian requires the ability to flex across both fundraising and investment functions. The Capital Formation team owns Investor Relations, the firm’s Strategic Investments program (Breakout Fund, LP co-invest, SPVs), and asset allocation. The team includes a mix of fundraisers, relationship managers, portfolio analysts, investment bankers, and investment professionals who specialize in later-stage or complex investment execution. This position offers meaningful exposure to deal execution and syndication across the Breakout Fund, LP co-invests, and SPVs (alongside core LP relationship management).

LP COVERAGE & RELATIONSHIP MANAGEMENT

You decide what each account is for, who it should bring in and what content grows it. Then you plan it, create it, publish it every day and adjust based on what the numbers tell you. This isn't a role for keeping the lights on: we want someone who will transform our socials and turn them into a super-engaged community that people actually want to be part of.
 You report to our Influencers & Partnerships Manager and have a designer for bigger creative pieces, but the thinking is yours and you're strong on graphics and short-form video yourself. We are looking for someone with 2+ years running organic social for a DTC or consumer brand, who has personally created and published the content and can show the accounts they grew and the numbers they moved.
 The mission of this role
 Own organic social for KittySpout and DoggySpout end to end across all social media channels. Success is accounts that keep growing and reach people who have never heard of us, with content created and published every day that grows an active, engaged community.
 Who are we?
 KittySpout is a premium DTC brand selling stainless steel cat water fountains, filters and accessories. We sell across Shopify, Amazon and Chewy, and we're one of the fastest-growing brands in the pet space – $50M+ in annual revenue and scaling to $100M+. We recently launched DoggySpout, expanding into an entirely new vertical and customer base. We're a 100% remote, lean, senior team that moves fast, and every person here has a massive impact on the business.
 What is our culture like & who is a good fit?
 Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We use creativity to do more with less – and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by four core values:
 Better Everyday – test a new format, hook or post style every week, keep what works and improve the calendar and reporting along the way.
 Speed Is King – get a trend live the day it's spotted, publish on time every day and answer the community within 24 hours.
 Work Smart – use AI and tools so your time goes to strategy and creating: batch and schedule posts ahead, let Claude draft hook and caption variations, and automate the Monday report.
 Overdeliver – bring new content ideas to the Influencers & Partnerships Manager before being asked, and tell the team fast when something flops and what you're changing.
 If you want a stress-free corporate 9–5 job, this isn't it. 
 If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founder, and play a big role in scaling it to $100M+... If you want to drive results with a group of passionate, smart, hardworking people, in an environment without politics or corporate chicanery, being hands-on and active – then you've come to the right place.
 Outcomes (what success looks like)
 90-day targets for each outcome are agreed with you before your start date. 
 Grow the audience on both brands – follower growth by brand and platform (Instagram, TikTok and Facebook insights)
 Reach people who have never heard of us – reach and non-follower reach per post by brand (platform insights)
 Content people save and share – saves, shares and engagement rate by brand (platform insights)
 Publish daily to plan on both brands – posts published per week per brand vs the content calendar (scheduling tool)
 An active, responsive community – comments and DMs answered within 24 hours, Facebook group activity (Instagram, Facebook, TikTok)
 Key Objectives
 Own the organic content strategy for KittySpout and DoggySpout across all social media channels.
 Plan the content calendar one week ahead per brand and platform, mixing content for the existing community with content built to reach new audiences.
 Create and publish every day: write the hooks and captions, shoot and edit short-form video, and design day-to-day graphics and stories.
 Spot trends daily and get trend content live the same day.
 Turn the creator and UGC content from our creator programs into organic posts that perform.
 Run the community: comments, DMs, our Facebook group and tagged mentions.
 Read the data every week and act on it: double down on what works and drop what doesn't.
 Fully remote, full-time
 Native-level written English
 Hands-on Organic Social: 2+ years personally running organic social for a DTC or consumer brand – creating and publishing the content yourself, not just approving it or managing an agency.
 Proof: Accounts you grew and numbers you moved. We will ask for this.
 Multi-brand, Multi-platform: You can run two brands across every social channel and tailor content to each instead of copying the same post everywhere.
 Design: You build clean, on-brand graphics and stories in Canva, Figma or similar without waiting on a designer.
 Hooks, Captions & Video: You write hooks that stop the scroll and shoot and edit short-form video to a solid standard.
 Trend Spotting: You're on TikTok and Instagram every day and spot trends before they peak.
 Data-driven: You read saves, shares, reach and engagement and change what you make because of it.
 Time Zone: Overlap with the US and Canada, where most of our audience is.
 No issue working overtime or on the weekends if needed. You are passionate about your work.
 Excellent cultural fit as per our values above.
 Excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founder.
 Bonus points: pet, home or wellness brand experience; working with creators or UGC.
 Accountabilities
 What you own. Each one is checked green, yellow or red every week. 
 Content strategy and calendar – Own the organic content strategy for both brands, plan next week's calendar per brand and platform and get it approved with the Influencers & Partnerships Manager, and get trend content live the same day.
 Create and publish daily – Write the hooks and captions, shoot and edit short-form video, design day-to-day graphics and stories, brief bigger pieces to the designer in advance, and follow brand guidelines and approved product claims on every post. Nothing missed, nothing late.
 Creator content – Review the creator and UGC content coming in from our creator programs, repurpose the best of it for organic, and feed back to the creator team on what works.
 Community – Reply to all comments and DMs within 24 hours across both brands, keep the Facebook group active, engage with tagged mentions, and flag customer issues to Customer Support the same day.
 Planning and reporting – Post daily priorities, deliver a performance report every Monday (what worked, what didn't and what you're changing), set organic social KPI targets with the Influencers & Partnerships Manager and update them on the department scorecard weekly, and join the weekly team meeting.
 How Our Hiring Works & How We Operate
 (1) Application + Screening
 (2) Test Project
 (3) Technical Interview
 (4) Culture Fit Interview
 Salary Expectation
 USD $3,000 – $4,500 per month (based on experience and expertise).

 The role 
 This is the senior seat on our Client Success team. We are hiring you to raise the standard of our support: fix what is broken, write down how it should work, and show what great looks like.
 Our AI agent now answers repeatable, well-documented questions. What is left is the work that only a person can do: own a client's problem from the first message to the confirmed fix, build a relationship a clerk trusts, and turn what you learn into better documentation and a better product.
 This is not a ticket-closing job. Think of a great 5-star hotel that puts slippers by the bed before you ask. We want a clerk to finish a conversation with you and tell the clerk in the next town about the great experience they had. If that takes three calls, take three calls.
 It is also a technical job. You will work with our developers every day. When something breaks, you work out where it lives before anyone else has to. Is the problem on the events calendar on the client's homepage, or in the calendar widget embedded on a department page? Is the wrong speaker name only in the transcript, or is it also in the finished minutes? You reproduce it, write it up so a developer can act without a follow-up question, stay on it until it ships, and tell the client yourself.
 You need both halves. A brilliant troubleshooter who is short with a clerk will not work here. Neither will a lovely person who forwards every problem to a developer.
 Your first 90 days 
 Learn all of our products well enough to teach them
 Take over every open escalation and close or schedule each one
 Rebuild the path from support to our developers so nothing leaves the queue untracked
 Find the ten questions clerks ask most and fix each at the source: an article, a Fin answer, or a product change

About Gusto 
 At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.
 All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy .
 AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.
 About the Role 
 This is your chance to own one of the most technical, horizontal levers in GTM planning: building the scalable models and infrastructure that enable every route to market to grow efficiently. As Senior Sales Operations Analyst, you’ll partner with GTM leaders, Finance, Revenue Operations, and GTM Ops to develop and execute segmentation, book-of-business design, quota setting, and capacity planning. You’ll turn GTM strategy into concrete, automated models that determine how customers are segmented, how reps are staffed, and what they are held accountable for.
 This role takes an end-to-end, platform-minded view across GTM motions, not just a single sales team. You’ll identify where manual work, fragmented logic, or inconsistent processes limit scale and build durable planning infrastructure that drives revenue outcomes as the business evolves. You’ll own the outcome: balanced books, defensible quotas tied to capacity, and scalable models that hold up under scrutiny.
 About the Team 
 You'll sit within GTM Operations, working as the dedicated segmentation, book-of-business, and capacity planning owner for our Direct, Expansion, and Benefits sales teams. We think of ourselves as builders and problem solvers: we turn ambiguous planning questions into scalable, defensible models, and we hold the line on rigor even when the business is moving fast and priorities compete.
 You'll work in close partnership with each organization's GTM leaders and their dedicated GTM Ops partners, leaning on their operational and business context, while you own building, defending, and maintaining the segmentation, book, quota, and headcount models that everyone plans against.
 Here's what you'll do day-to-day 
 Segmentation & Book of Business 
 Own the design and ongoing maintenance of customer/account segmentation for Direct, Expansion, and Benefits sales, translating org-level segmentation strategy into concrete, rules-based models these teams can operate against.
 Build and maintain balanced books of business across reps and teams, accounting for account potential, workload, geography, and product mix; own rebalancing when the business shifts (new hires, departures, territory changes, book splits).
 Set and maintain clear, documented rules for account assignment, routing, and reclassification, and serve as the ruling authority when edge cases or disputes come up.
 Partner with Sales, GTM Ops, and Systems & Tooling to ensure segmentation and book structures are reflected accurately in Salesforce and downstream systems.
 Quota Setting 
 Own the end-to-end quota-setting process for Direct, Expansion, and Benefits: translating top-down revenue targets into bottoms-up, capacity-based quotas by rep, team, and segment.
 Build and maintain the quota models and methodology, ensuring quotas are defensible, equitable across territories/books, and tightly tied to book-of-business design and headcount capacity.
 Partner with RTM leaders, Finance, and Sales Compensation to align quotas with comp plans, revenue targets, and business priorities each planning cycle.
 Own quota administration through the cycle: true-ups for territory or book changes, new-hire ramp adjustments, and mid-cycle corrections.
 Headcount & Capacity Planning 
 Partner with GTM Ops & Finance on capacity planning for Direct, Expansion, and Benefits: modeling the headcount needed to cover segmented books and hit revenue targets, and identifying where the org is over- or under-staffed relative to opportunity.
 Build the headcount models that inform hiring plans, partnering with RTM leaders and Finance on timing, sequencing, and prioritization of new roles.
 Continuously monitor capacity against actual book size, productivity, and attrition, flagging gaps or imbalances before they become a problem.
 Own scenario planning for headcount and territory changes (reorgs, new segments, M&A, product launches), modeling the impact before decisions are made.
 Cross-functional Partnership & Communication 
 Partner closely with RTM leaders and their GTM Ops partners across Direct, Expansion, and Benefits to ensure segmentation, book, quota, and capacity decisions reflect real operational context, while retaining ownership of the outcome and the execution.
 Work with GTM Ops, Finance, and Sales Compensation to stay aligned with org-wide segmentation frameworks, revenue targets, and comp design.
 Communicate clearly and proactively with sales leadership on plan status, tradeoffs, and risk: you're the trusted authority on "how the books, quotas, and headcount are built and why."
 Document methodology and decisions so segmentation, quota, and capacity models are transparent, auditable, and repeatable across planning cycles.
 Here's what we're looking for 
 5+ years in Sales Ops, RevOps, or a similar analytical GTM role, with direct, hands-on experience owning segmentation, territory/book design, quota setting, or headcount/capacity planning; ideally in a fast-paced SaaS or fintech environment.
 Proven ability to own outcomes and execution, not just analysis or recommendations: you're comfortable being the accountable owner when a quota, book, or headcount plan is challenged.
 Strong sales process & tooling proficiency: you can build and audit account assignment/routing logic, manage territory and book structures, and build reporting that leaders trust.
 Analytical depth; comfortable building and defending quantitative models (quota, capacity, segmentation) under time pressure.
 Experience running planning processes on a recurring cadence (annual/quarterly quota setting, ongoing book rebalancing, headcount reviews) across multiple stakeholder groups.
 Excellent written and verbal communication; you can defend a model's methodology to GTM leaders and senior sales leadership, and hold your ground when a decision is unpopular but correct.
 A first-principles problem solver who can build a defensible model from ambiguous inputs and translate org-level strategy into concrete, rules-based execution.
 A strong cross-functional partner, able to work closely with GTM leaders and GTM Ops peers without ceding ownership of the outcome.
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience owning segmentation, book-of-business, or quota/capacity planning across multiple sales organizations or motions simultaneously (e.g., new business, expansion, and a distinct product line).
 Experience in payroll, HR tech, benefits, or SMB SaaS go-to-market motions.
 Experience partnering with Sales Compensation and Finance on quota-to-comp alignment.
 Experience designing or improving account assignment/routing automation (e.g., lead-routing tools, rules engines).
 Compensation 
 Our cash compensation amount for this role is targeted at $100,000 - $120,000/yr in Scottsdale, $105,000 - $130,000/yr in Denver and Atlanta, $130,000 - $155,000/yr in San Francisco and New York, and $120,000 - $145,000 CAD/yr for Toronto. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate experience and expertise and may vary from the amounts listed above.
 At Gusto, we don't use titles the traditional way, as a signal of rank or hierarchy. Instead, our titles describe two things at once — your craft (what you do, e.g. Engineering, Design) and your scope of ownership (what you're accountable for) — which is why you'll see something like "Head of X" instead of a rank word like "Director" that tells you neither. Because of this, the title on this posting may look different from what you'd expect based on the scope and seniority of the role, and from how similar roles are typically titled elsewhere.  Our customers come from all walks of life and so do we. We hire great people from a wide variety of backgrounds, not just because it's the right thing to do, but because it makes our company stronger. If you share our values and our enthusiasm for small businesses, you will find a home at Gusto.

We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. About Behavox 
 Behavox is a cloud-native AI company providing an integrated controls platform for global banks, asset managers, hedge funds, private equity firms, insurance businesses, and commodity firms. The platform unifies communications and trade surveillance, compliant archiving, policy management as well as front-office analytics on a single, AI-native technology stack, delivered as a globally scalable SaaS-based cloud service.
 At Behavox, our engineering culture is built around speed, experimentation, and technical excellence, following agile principles and rapid iteration. We constantly test and adopt the latest cloud technologies and AI tooling, optimising for fast feedback loops and execution. We look for people who can move fast, challenge conventional wisdom, and who want to work at the frontier of modern AI, SaaS platforms, and distributed systems.
 Behavox is a high-performance organisation with a strong bias toward delivery, ownership, and responsibility. We commit, and we execute. We are building systems that are complex, mission-critical, and global in scale; systems that many consider too large or too difficult. To do that, we seek the smartest, most technically capable engineers and technologists who take end-to-end responsibility and want to win by building what others cannot.
 Founded in 2014 and backed by SoftBank Vision Fund, Behavox is headquartered in London, with offices worldwide, including New York City, Montreal, Seattle, Singapore, and Tokyo.
 About the Role 
 The Senior FP&A Analyst owns Behavox's core financial model — its architecture, the accounting beneath it, and the forecasts and analysis the company plans and decides by. The role exists to change decisions, not report them: it turns the numbers into the choices leadership actually faces. It reads and integrates budgets into the model, but does not run the budgeting cycle.
 The same analyst builds the valuations, scenarios, and pro-forma models behind every acquisition — evaluating targets, running diligence, and folding closed deals into a single consolidated view. This work is periodic and must be carried alone when it arrives; the steady state is the operating model and SaaS forecasting.
 This is a high-autonomy role that works without a detailed brief and sets the modeling standard others build on. It is accountable for the accuracy and integrity of the numbers, and for turning them into recommendations sharp enough to act on — the downside case included, not just the point estimate — for senior leadership, the board, and investors. It pressure-tests the assumptions behind every result, works fluently with modern tooling and AI, and compounds that edge by learning relentlessly. Its influence comes from the rigor and reach of the analysis, not from authority: it owns the model and the truth it tells, not the decisions made from it.
 What You'll Bring 
 Financial Model & Accounting Foundations — Knows how an integrated three-statement and operating model fits together, and the accounting that holds it up — SaaS revenue recognition and cost treatment included. Understands exactly how the company's budgets are built, and folds them into the model.
 Forecasting & SaaS Unit Economics — Knows both bottom-up short-term forecasting and driver-based long-term modeling, and the SaaS metrics that actually reveal performance. Knows what moves each one and which lever changes it — not just how to report it.
 Mergers, Acquisitions & Integration — Knows how to value an acquisition and how to fold it into one consolidated model: purchase accounting, combined-entity projections, and the mechanics that make or break the integration.
 Business & Commercial Acumen — Knows in depth how the business and every function make money — the revenue drivers, the cost structure, the operating levers — and spots a number that doesn't add up on sight.
 Financial Systems & AI Tooling — Commands Google Sheets and Excel, and tracks the AI and automation landscape closely enough to know where it is trustworthy and where it isn't.
 What You'll Do 
 Financial Model Ownership — Builds and maintains the core three-statement and operating model with scenario and sensitivity layers, and keeps it accurate, clean, and easy to maintain. Integrates budgets without owning the cycle, and owns the accuracy of every output and the integrity of every assumption.
 Acquisition Modeling & Integration — Builds the valuations, scenarios, and pro-forma combined-entity models behind acquisition evaluation and due diligence, and folds closed deals into a single consolidated view.
 Business-Review Reporting — Drives much of the substance of the monthly, quarterly, and annual business reviews — with the broader FP&A team — for senior management, the board, and investors, turning the model into a narrative that explains what moved the results and what it means for the business.
 Metrics Analysis & Business Partnering — Diagnoses why the metrics are moving and which lever changes them, pressure-tests the assumptions behind every result, and hands the decision-maker a recommendation they can act on.
 AI-Enabled Productivity — Uses AI and spreadsheet automation to compress cycle time and harden data validation — automating the recurring work while keeping judgment on what stays manual.
 What We Offer 
 The opportunity to work on a global, mission-critical AI platform alongside the best engineers and technologists across multiple geographies.
 A role with real ownership and impact, building complex systems at scale in an environment that values speed, experimentation, and technical excellence.
 A highly attractive benefits package, including competitive cash compensation, and an equity award aligned with long-term value creation.
 Modern, comfortable offices in Toronto and Montreal. This is a hybrid role (1 day in office). 
 A generous time-off policy of 30 days annually, plus public holidays and sick leave, recognizing the importance of sustained high performance.
 About Our Process 
 We take Talent very seriously and we are building a community of extraordinary individuals working together in very high performing teams. We also know that the best Talent always has options so we believe that the process has to be a two way assessment - the company AND the candidate assessing the business needs alignment, the career next step alignment, and the cultural alignment. 
During the process we will begin by exploring the core factors regarding salary and location along with core experience and skills and values alignment. We will then deep dive explore the critical technical competencies we have identified for the role, and then we will deep dive in behavioral competencies.
The most aligned candidate will then be asked to do a practical work task simulation activity so we can make sure that you will enjoy the kind of work the role requires, and this task will typically be presented and discussed with a group of colleagues and managers. Finally we will ask you to meet with a number of our senior leaders to make sure that you are making the most informed call possible.

 We want to get to know you and have a genuine conversation, so the use of AI tools or assistance during live interviews is strictly prohibited and will result in immediate disqualification from the process

Our culture
